title: Open Telco
domain: GSMA's eight telecom tests, from 3GPP standards and maths to 5G root-cause analysis and 6G reasoning.
good_to_know: Lite is GSMA's sample of each test, the one its leaderboard ranks; Full is the whole test.
Each test is a dataset scored on its own. The leaderboard's average is the mean of the tests' accuracies.
An answer counts only in the form its prompt asks for: 'ANSWER: <letter>', a \boxed{} value, or a working group's code.
upstream_limitations: 3GPP TSG's scorer cannot read RAN_AH1: its 6 Lite and 129 Full questions always fail, so 94% and 93.6% are the ceilings (gsma-labs/evals#81).
TeleMath's scorer accepts any number within 0.01 of the answer, looser than its 1% for answers between -1 and 1 (44 Lite, 245 Full): 0 passes on 10 Lite and 47 Full questions whose answer is not 0.
The multiple-choice prompt asks for 'ANSWER: $LETTER': a reply that keeps the dollar sign is scored wrong, on all five multiple-choice tests (gsma-labs/evals#73).
limitations: An agent gets TeleMath's system prompt and the question as one prompt: ACP has no system message.
TeleLogs' majority vote across epochs (maj@k) is not computed; several attempts give pass@k instead.
